ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Receiving emptiness and answering an echo is responding to what has no substance of one’s own. Chan speakers apply the paired image to inherited talk and imitative responses, often immediately contrasting it with a present demand or blow.
EvidenceBody: Yinyuan Longqi contrasts empty reception with working the local ground; Chaozong applies it to inherited talk; Tianyin Xiu warns the echo-following person not to move; Baiyu Jingsi applies the phrase to Kasyapa in the flower-sermon case; and Lianyue forbids it while raising the whisk.
